# MeetMind - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it — in plain text for AI agents and answer engines.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: MeetMind
- Tagline: Turn any meeting into clear, actionable notes
- Domain: https://meeting-mind-mvp.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does
- Paste a transcript or jot the topic and get AI-generated meeting minutes in seconds \u2014 a tight summary, the key decisions, and action items with owners and due dates.
- Summary, decisions and action items
- Auto-assigned owners and due dates
- Multiple formats (bullets, email, Slack)
- One-click follow-up draft

## Pricing (USD)
- **Free** — $0 — 5 notes/day, bullets format
- **Starter** — $29/mo — Unlimited notes, all formats, follow-ups
- **Pro** — $79/mo — Team workspace, Slack/email export, API
- Checkout: https://meeting-mind-mvp.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://meeting-mind-mvp.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. Do I need to install anything?
A1. No. MeetMind runs in your browser.
Q2. Is my input kept private?
A2. We use it only to generate your result and minimize retention. See Security.
Q3. Does it guarantee compliance / correctness?
A3. No. It is decision-support; you own the final call. See the honesty note in Security.
Q4. Can I export the result?
A4. Yes — JSON and CSV.
Q5. Is there an API?
A5. Yes, the web form is backed by a REST endpoint you can call from your pipeline.
